reports.title: A Grand Place to Fill Your Livewell, by Brent Frazee
reports.text:
His hat is appropriate as crappie guide Haydn Williams is often “On ‘em” as he fishes boat docks on Grand Lake o’ the Cherokees in Oklahoma to catch big crappies. (Photo: Brent Frazee)
Haydn Williams looked at the screen of the forward-facing sonar on his boat and saw the crappie fishing equivalent of the jackpot.
The screen was filled with a live view full of crappies – hundreds of them milling around from 15 to 35 feet down.
“There are crappies that never leave the docks on this lake,” said Williams, 23, who operates Williams Guide Service. “They live there. They have everything they need there – shade, food, spawning habitat, even a place to get away from fishing pressure. They live a…
